'''Dumb missiles''' were basic unguided [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. They cost five hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per [[Missile/Legends|missile]], and could be used with the [[Morne-3 Concussion Missile Launcher]].<ref name="PP" />
